items.difficulty_reason: 47 行、两向等价：①茎词典 (f^{-1}O_S)_x = R_p、E_x = M^bullet_q；②正向：模复形的 tor amplitude 经局部化保持 + 茎判别引理给 E 的 amplitude；③反向：茎判别给出逐素理想局部化 statements，用 more-algebra-lemma-tor-amplitude-localization 收回 M^bullet 整体；④(2) 由拟紧性取一致 [a,b] 从 (1) 得出。承重的两个方向与拟紧归约都在 span 内；2 处跨章引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-tor-dimension-rel-affine (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2551-2565

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the identification of stalks of E with localizations of M^bullet, the two directions of the tor amplitude equivalence via the stalk criterion for tor amplitude and the localization criterion for tor amplitude of complexes, and the deduction of the local finite tor dimension statement from quasi-compactness (source lines 2567-2597)
